2608.06294.title: QuanTiMedAI: Quantum-Enhanced Time-Series Model guided by Agentic AI for Cardiac Arrest Mortality Prediction
2608.06294.paper_summary: Cardiac arrest remains one of the most lethal conditions encountered in intensive care units. Despite the growing availability of electronic health record data, existing mortality prediction studies in this population largely depend on static summaries derived from early admission. Such approaches ignore the temporal progression of physiological deterioration and recovery that unfolds throughout a patient's ICU stay. To address this limitation, we introduce QuanTiMedAI, a quantum-agentic framework developed for cardiac arrest mortality prediction using agentic AI guided quantum enhancement time series model. The proposed system combines an agentic large language model (LLM) for clinically informed feature discovery with a compact quantum recurrent network for temporality aware mortality prediction. Our findings demonstrate that agentic LLM-guided feature selection consistently outperforms conventional feature selection approaches, and the proposed quantum architecture achieves competitive predictive performance through nonlinear feature enhancement while keeping the number of parameters very low. Through extensive experimentation on a MIMIC-IV cohort of cardiac arrest patients, QuanTiMedAI's quantum-enhanced architecture attains an AUROC of 0.852 using only 605 parameters, an improvement of approximately 2.9\% over a current state-of-the-art baseline for this task. A structured ablation study systematically validates the contribution of each architectural design choice. These results show that quantum-enhanced sequential modeling can exceed classical recurrent networks while using substantially fewer parameters.
2608.06294.paper_summary_zh: 心臟驟停仍然是重症監護病房中最致命的病症之一。儘管電子健康紀錄數據的可用性不斷增長，但在這一人群中的現有死亡率預測研究主要依賴於早期入院所衍生的靜態摘要。這些方法忽略了在患者重症監護病房住院期間生理惡化和恢復的時間進程。為了解決這一限制，我們推出了QuanTiMedAI，一個為心臟驟停死亡率預測而開發的量子代理框架，使用由代理人工智慧引導的量子增強時間序列模型。所提出的系統結合了用於臨床知識驅動特徵發現的代理大型語言模型（LLM）和用於時間性意識死亡率預測的緊湊量子遞歸網絡。我們的研究結果顯示，代理LLM引導的特徵選擇始終優於傳統的特徵選擇方法，而所提出的量子架構通過非線性特徵增強實現了具有競爭力的預測性能，同時保持了非常低的參數數量。通過對心臟驟停患者的MIMIC-IV隊列進行廣泛實驗，QuanTiMedAI的量子增強架構在僅使用605個參數的情況下達到了0.852的AUROC，較目前這項任務的最先進基準提高了約2.9%。一項結構化的消融研究系統性地驗證了每個架構設計選擇的貢獻。這些結果表明，量子增強的序列建模可以超越傳統的遞歸網絡，同時使用的參數數量大大減少。
